translated: And it happened that Jesus went to Jerusalem, and when he entered the temple, he began to drive out those who were selling and buying in the temple, and he overturned the tables of the money changers and the seats of those who were selling doves. But you have made it a den of robbers." And the chief priests and the scribes heard it and sought how they might destroy him, for they feared him, because all the people were astonished at his teaching. And when evening came, Jesus and his disciples went out of the city.

translated: The Lord is my shepherd, I lack nothing. He makes me lie down in green pastures, He leads me beside quiet waters, He refreshes my soul.
